title: LEM Products Distribution Recalls 5-Tray Food Dehydrators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fan can fail causing the unit to overheat and pose a fire hazard. Units: About 14,600 in the U.S, and 100 in Canada. This product was previously recalled in February 2011..

title: Louisville Slugger OneX Fastpitch Softball Bats Recalled by Hillerich & Bradsby Due to Injury Hazard from Breakage
summary: The bat's barrel can separate from the handle during use and strike people nearby. Units: About 13,000.

title: Avon Recalls Microwave Popcorn Maker Due to Burn and Fire Hazards; New Instructions Provided
summary: When cooked too long, the popcorn can overheat in this popcorn maker and ignite, posing a fire or burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 54,700.

title: Deezo Children’s Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by Zulily Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts and jackets have drawstrings through the hood which pose a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 560.

title: Powell Company Recalls Anywhere Lounger Bean Bag Chairs Due to Suffocation and Strangulation Hazards
summary: Bean bag chairs without a permanent zipper closure allow young children to unzip, ingest or inhale the small beads inside of the bean bag chair, posing a suffocation and strangulation hazard. Units: About 6,300.

title: Optimus Recalls Portable Electric Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The heater design can fail to prevent ignition of nearby combustible materials that come in contact with the unit, posing a fire hazard to the consumer. Units: About 355,000.

title: Meijer Recalls Touch Point Baseboard Convection Heaters Due to a Fire Hazard
summary: The heaters can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,560.

title: Family Dollar Stores Recalls Optimus Tower Quartz Heaters Due to Overheating and Fire Hazards
summary: The heaters can overheat posing a fire hazard. Units: About 19,640.

title: Toro Recalls Zero Turn Riding Mowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The idler pulley can rub against the mower's fuel tank, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,700 in the U.S. and 60 in Canada (about 2,600 units were previously recalled in the U.S. and 30 in Canada in November 2012).

title: Surly Bikes Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle fork can bend above the disc brake mount, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 975.

title: Fred Meyer Recalls "Chicken Dance" Easter Chicks Due to Hearing Damage Hazard
summary: The toy's music can reach decibel levels that exceed ASTM F963 standard, posing a hearing damage hazard. Units: About 1,000.

title: Teavana Recalls Glass Tea Tumblers Due To Laceration and Burn Hazards
summary: The glass tea tumblers can break or shatter unexpectedly, posing laceration and burn hazards. Units: About 445,000 in the U.S, and 24,850 in Canada.

title: H&M Reannounces Recall of Children's Water Bottles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The water bottle's spout can break off, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 2,900 (previously recalled in Sept. 2012).

title: Hammary Furniture Recalls Dining Side Chairs Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The connections between the legs and frame of the chairs can flex, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 165.

title: KTM North America Recalls KTM and Husaberg Motorcycles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: During use, the throttle cable can malfunction and result in an uncontrollable throttle. This poses a crash hazard to the rider. Units: About 7,000.

title: Pottery Barn Kids Recalls Sweet Lambie Crib Bumpers Due to Entanglement Hazard
summary: The thread in the decorative stitching on the bumper can loosen, posing an entanglement hazard to infants. Units: About 12,000.

title: Vive La Fete Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 710.

title: GNU Snowboard Bindings Recalled by Mervin Manufacturing Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The ankle straps can break posing a fall hazard. Units: About 6,800 pairs in the U.S. and 1,200 in Canada.

title: Nourison Recalls Rugs Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: The rugs fail to meet federal flammability standards, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,400.

title: Insolroll Recalls Roller Shades with Solar and Rechargeable Motors Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The motor of these roller shades has a built-in lithium battery that can overheat while being charged, posing a fire risk. Units: About 1,500.

title: Kubota Recalls Riding Mowers Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel tank's pressure relief valve can malfunction, causing the tank to expand and rub against the transmission drive belt and drive cooling fan. This can wear a hole in the fuel tank and cause a fuel leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 8,600.

title: Lea Industries Recalls Children’s Beds Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bed's side mattress support rails can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 59,200 in the U.S. and 4,200 in Canada.
